errors.evidence: The description states that the countries on the horizontal axis are sorted alphabetically, but they are sorted in descending order based on their corresponding values on the vertical axis.
The description states that the lowest values (for Romania, Croatia, and Hungary) are around 0.6, but the chart shows these values are all above 0.7, closer to 0.75-0.78.
